subject: Obsidian Systems — Private deployment connectivity & staging cadence
messages:
From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Tim Liao <tim.liao@obsidian.tech>, Ops Team <ops@obsidian.tech>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-03-20T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Obsidian Systems — Private deployment connectivity & staging cadence

Hi Tim / Obsidian Ops,

Thanks again for the productive call yesterday. We want to lock down a short, staged connectivity plan so the on-prem package can get installed in your lab cluster next week and then promoted to staging. High-level goals for this thread:

- Confirm CIDR mappings and peering window for VPC peering (we need a /16 split for the app plane and /20 for telemetry).
- Validate private endpoint configuration and TLS mutual-auth expectations.
- Collect a minimal on-prem inventory and where the router NAT/GW will terminate (we need public egress for package download + outbound to KMS).
- Agree on a 2-hour network review slot for Tuesday 3/21 or Wednesday 3/22 (Redwood and Obsidian network engineers).

I've attached an initial inventory template and our install manifest (obsidian_network_inventory.xlsx, redwood_onprem_install_manifest.pdf). Please also send any ACL or perimeter firewall rules that will be applied (we can accept a text file or screenshot).

Action items for Tim / Ops before the review:
1) Populate the inventory with device models, firmware, and NAT details.
2) Share tentative CIDR ranges you'd like to reserve for the private endpoints and peering.
3) Confirm whether you will use a dedicated transit gateway or route-based peering.

If the three items are in place we can run our on-prem package in your lab and validate the KV cache/prefix caching behavior under a controlled token load. Proposed review window: Tue 3/21 10:00–12:00 PT or Wed 3/22 14:00–16:00 PT.

Thanks — GRACE
Grace O'Connor
Senior Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
grace.oconnor@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0198

Attachments referenced: obsidian_network_inventory.xlsx, redwood_onprem_install_manifest.pdf

From: Tim Liao <tim.liao@obsidian.tech>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>, Ops Team <ops@obsidian.tech>
Cc: Sophie Park <sophie.park@obsidian.tech>
Date: 2028-03-20T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Obsidian Systems — Private deployment connectivity & staging cadence

Grace — thanks, appreciate the clear list. Quick answers and a couple of clarifying Qs:

- Inventory: attaching a filled draft (obsidian_network_inventory.xlsx). Lab router is a Cisco ASR1001; prod edge will be AWS TGW with route-based peering.
- CIDR: proposing we reserve 10.40.0.0/16 for the app plane and 10.41.0.0/20 for telemetry/metrics as you suggested. We have spare /24s for future pods.
- ACLs: our perimeter ACLs are stateful and we allow outbound 443/4432 for vendor updates. Will share firewall rule export in vpc-peering-acls.txt.

Questions:
1) For TLS mutual auth, do you require client certs from our side for every private endpoint, or will mTLS be terminated at a Redwood gateway? We prefer certs managed in our KMS.
2) What IPs should we whitelist for initial package download vs. long-term peering?

We can do the Tues 3/21 10:00–12:00 PT slot. Adding Sophie (networks) to coordinate.

—Tim
Tim Liao
Head of Infrastructure | Obsidian Systems
tim.liao@obsidian.tech | +1 617-555-0112

Attachments referenced: obsidian_network_inventory.xlsx, vpc-peering-acls.txt

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>, Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>
Cc: Tim Liao <tim.liao@obsidian.tech>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-03-21T08:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Obsidian Systems — Private deployment connectivity & staging cadence

Quick internal note before the review:

- Prep checklist I've added to the install manifest: PKI flow for mTLS, KMS endpoint patterns, and HSM reachability. Reducing outbound requirements is preferred — we'll pull packages via a signed artifact proxy if Obsidian wants to keep egress locked down.
- For the lab run, plan: 1) peering smoke test, 2) private endpoint creation + cert exchange, 3) on-prem package install (single node), 4) load verification at 50 rps for 10 minutes to confirm KV cache warmup.
- Bring the following to the call: hop-by-hop traceroutes, BGP session configs (if using TGW with BGP), and any source-NAT rules on the edge.

I attached the latest redwood_onprem_install_manifest.pdf to the thread.

—Ben
Ben Carter
Implementation Lead | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com

From: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>
To: Tim Liao <tim.liao@obsidian.tech>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>, Ops Team <ops@obsidian.tech>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-03-21T15:47:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Obsidian Systems — Private deployment connectivity & staging cadence

Thanks all — confirmed for Tue 3/21 10:00–12:00 PT. Agenda for the 2-hour review:

1) 10:00–10:20 — Quick intros and success criteria recap (Grace + Tim).
2) 10:20–10:45 — Network topology walk (Obsidian to present hop-by-hop).
3) 10:45–11:15 — mTLS and PKI exchange plan (Ben to outline cert flow).
4) 11:15–11:40 — On-prem package install prerequisites & artifact delivery (Monica).
5) 11:40–12:00 — Acceptance gates and next steps (smoke test sign-off owner + dates).

Pre-reads uploaded here: https://drive.google.com/obsidian-implementation-plan (includes the install manifest and an example peering ACL). Tim — please post the vpc-peering-acls.txt to the drive before 9:00 PT tomorrow so Ben can pre-scan rules.

If there's anything else you want included in the agenda, reply-ALL and we'll slot it. Looking forward to the lab run.

Best — Camila
Camila Reyes
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
camila.reyes@redwood.com | +1 650-555-0133

Attachments referenced: redwood_onprem_install_manifest.pdf
